announcements.text: J.F. Brennan Co. Inc., La Crosse, Wisconsin, was awarded a firm-fixed-price contract for construction of aquatic nuisance species deterrents, including automated barge clearing deterrent, bubble curtain deterrent, and acoustic deterrent, as well as associated demolition, excavation, building systems, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, structural, and site restoration work. announcements.text: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. is being awarded a modification to the active Prototype Project Other Transaction Agreement (HQ0851-22-9-0002) with a value of $475,297,523. This is an increase in dollar value of the current Agreement from $832,778,556 to $1,308,076,079. The Agreement was previously awarded through the Missile Defense Agency’s authority under 10 U.S. Code 4022(a)(2)(B). Under this award, the performer will continue to develop and define its Glide Phase Interceptor design concept with an accelerated schedule. The estimated completion date is June 2028. Funds from Section 20003 of Public Law 119-21 in the amount of $174,133,086 are being obligated at the time of award. Missile Defense Agency, Dahlgren, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded April 3, 2026).

announcements.text: Castellano Cobra UTE MACC LEY 18-1982, Cádiz, Spain (N3319126D0002); Constructora San Josa SA, Sevilla, Spain (N3319126D0003); Elecnor Servicios y Projectos, Sevilla, Spain (N3319126D0004); Environmental Chemical Corp. Italy S.R.L., Sevilla, Spain (N3319126D0005); Sociedad Espanola de Montajes Industriales SA, Cádiz, Spain (N3319126D0006); and UTE MACC Rota 2024, Sevilla, Spain (N3319126D0007), are awarded a combined $100,000,000 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, design-build, design-bid-build, multiple award, construction contract. This contract provides for new construction, repair, alteration, and related demolition of existing infrastructure. Work will be performed at Naval Station Rota, Spain, and may include work at other facilities in Spain and Portugal, and is expected to be completed by March 2034. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance (Navy) (O&M, N) funds in the amount of $25,000 will be obligated to five awardees at time of award to satisfy the minimum guarantee and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Sociedad Espanola de Montajes Industriales SA is being awarded the initial task order at $4,944,139 for major interior and exterior renovation to the Pinz Bowling Center at Naval Station Rota, Spain. Work for this task order is expected to be completed by August 2028. Future task orders will be primarily funded by O&M, N; and military construction defense agencies contract funds. This contract was competitively procured via SAM.gov website, with 13 offers received. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Europe, Africa, Central Command, Naples, Italy, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Marinette Marine Corp., Marinette, Wisconsin, is awarded a $30,000,000 not-to-exceed undefinitized contract action for advance procurement of long lead time material and associated engineering and design activities in support of four Medium Landing Ship Block 1. Work will be performed in Marinette, Wisconsin (46%); De Pere, Wisconsin (39%); and Kenner, Louisiana (15%). Work is expected to be completed by September 2027. This contract is based on Section 128(b) of the Servicemembers Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025, Pub. L. No. 118-159. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N00024-26-C-2430).

announcements.text: Raytheon, Tucson, Arizona, was awarded a $14,055,719 modification to a previously awarded contract (N00024-26-C-5434) for technical and design agent engineering in support of the Evolved SeaSparrow Missile and NATO SeaSparrow Missile Systems programs. This modification combines purchases for the Navy (66%); and the governments of Australia, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, and Türkiye under Memorandum of Agreements (34%). Work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona (97%); and Portsmouth, Rhode Island (3%), and is expected to be completed by Dec. 31, 2030. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $7,794,089 (28%); fiscal 2025 other customer funds in the amount of $6,900,597 (25%); fiscal 2026 weapons procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $6,073,872 (22%); fiscal 2025 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $2,941,473 (10%); fiscal 2026 other customer funds in the amount of $2,755,875 (10%); fiscal 2026 other procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $1,077,196 (4%); fiscal 2025 weapons procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $382,045 (1%); and fiscal 2025 research, development, test, and evaluation (Navy) $200,000 (<1%), were obligated at time of award, of which $2,941,473 will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity. (Awarded Apr. 10, 2026).

Work will be performed at Norman, Oklahoma, and is expected to be completed by April 14, 2031. This contract was a competitive acquisition with two offers received. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $17,061,957 are being obligated at time of award.
